note: Checked by the audit on every generated site. Phrases are matched case-insensitively against visible text; Claude is also told to avoid them.
rules: No invented testimonials, reviews, star ratings, client logos, awards or statistics. A concept has no customers yet.
No stock-photo clichés: handshakes, people pointing at laptops, smiling call-centre headsets, lightbulbs.
No purple-to-blue gradients, glassmorphism cards stacked on gradients, or emoji as icons.
One display face and one body face. Never more than two families.
One accent colour, used for actions and a few highlights, not for whole sections.
At most three signature motion moves per page, and never two pinned scenes in a row.
Only the four motion system easings. No bounce except press feedback.
Headlines say something specific about the business. No generic 'Welcome to X'.
Every image needs meaningful alt text; decorative images use empty alt.
Body text at least 16px on mobile; tap targets at least 44px.
The page must say it is a concept, near the top and in the footer.
